summary: Amends the county charter so that, after January 1, 2027, the County Council needs four of its five members' votes — instead of a simple majority — to create a new tax or raise a tax rate on its own authority, without a public vote. Fees, rates, charges, special assessments, taxes already in place by that date, and renewals that do not raise the rate are not covered.
what_yes_means: A yes vote requires four of the five council members to agree before the council can create or raise a covered tax on its own after January 1, 2027.
what_no_means: A no vote keeps the current simple-majority council vote for those tax decisions.
